minimize_fx_graph: minimize a failing PyTorch FX graph with given inputs using delta debugging and suffix truncation strategies
propagate_concrete_values: propagate concrete tensor values through an FX graph interpreter with optional disk offloading for delta debugging
create_minified_hlo_graph: create a minified StableHLO graph from a minified FX graph and archive it to a local directory
convert_node_to_placeholder: convert an FX graph node with concrete values into a placeholder node to eliminate dead code during minimization
dump_minified_state: dump a minified FX graph and its inputs as printable Python code for debugging reproduction
